verdict.rationale: Proton Pass has a dedicated first-party support page on using passkeys (pass-use-passkeys), which describes passwordless sign-in for online accounts. That goes beyond the TOTP generation documented separately. The evidence is a single generic line, though, so the details of storage and sign-in are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of storing and syncing passkeys in the vault, passkey sign-in in native apps (not just websites), and platform coverage details, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
